title: 消費者心理学
subtitle: Psychology of Consumer
educationalGoal: Students will learn about: (1) how to analyze consumer behavior from the perspective of basic psychology (psychology of perception, memories, emotion, cognitive psychology, and social psychology). (2) psychological study of consumer behavior.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Consumer behavior from the perspective of the psychology of perception and sensation 2. Purchasing behavior from the perspective of the psychology of memories and learning 3. Advertisement from the perspective of cognitive and social psychology 4. Interpersonal influence in consumer behavior 5. Methodology of studying the psychology of consumers This course is subject to the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand the influence of perception and sensation on consumer behavior.
Ability to understand the relationship between cognitive processing, memories and purchasing behavior.
Ability to understand the influence of emotion and social environment on consumer behavior.
Ability to understand psychological research and experiments of consumer behavior.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
